title: Todd Monken: Giants coach John Harbaugh is ‘about winning football’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken: Giants coach John Harbaugh is ‘about winning football’
sources.description: Todd Monken is busy trying to figure out how to build the Cleveland Browns team he now coaches into a winner. Ask Monken about his former boss with the Baltimore Ravens, New York Giants new head coach John Harbaugh, and Monken doesn’t mind putting that task aside. “How much time do we have?,” Monken replied […]
